title: Phyn Plus Reading Weekly Pressure Trend
dataSources: Whole-home water flow (`watermeter:flow`), sump pump (`sumppump:event`), well pump (`wellpump:event`), pool/spa chemistry (`pool:chemistry`), water softener (`watersoftener:status`), irrigation zones (`irrigation:zone`).
app: Smart water meters (Flume/Flo/HomeWizard), sump- and well-pump sensors, pool/spa controllers, water-softener and irrigation controllers via vendor APIs, MQTT, and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=phyn:plus pressure_psi=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(pressure_psi) as avg_duration, max(pressure_psi) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst pressure for Phyn Plus reading events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture pressure_psi on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average pressure with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It reviews whether Phyn Plus reading tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
